//@version=5
indicator("QB diagnostic expansion primitives v5", overlay=false)
phase = bar_index % 12
v = phase == 0 or phase == 3 ? na : phase == 1 ? 1.0 : phase == 2 ? 3.0 : phase == 8 ? 4.0 : 2.0
plot(phase, title="phase")
plot(v, title="controlled_value")
plot(ta.cum(v), title="cum")
plot(ta.stoch(v,v,v,3), title="stoch")
plot(ta.linreg(v,3,0), title="linreg")
plot(ta.linreg(v,3,1), title="linreg_offset_1")
